entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The petitioner has challenged the order dated 06.07.2023 passed in Gosaninuagaon P.S. Case N o . 1 3 o f 2 0 2 1 a r i s i n g o u t o f G . R . C a s e N o . 4 9 o f 2 0 2 1 f o r t h e o f f e n c e s u n d e r Sections-366/366-A/376(2)(n) IPC r/w Section-6 of the POCSO Act by which the N.B.W. has been issued against him by the learned Addl. Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge (POCSO) Berhampur,
Ganjam.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner was granted bail on 21.06.2021.

However, the petitioner did not appear before the learned Court below leading to issuance of N.B.W.
against him on 06.07.2023.
However, the same could not be executed.

Therefore, the impugned order dated 06.07.2023 issued against the petitioner for execution of the N.B.W.
3.
Learned counsel for the petitioner on instruction submits that the petitioner would be appearing before the learned Court below on or before 10.04.2024 and seek remedy available to him under law.

4. On the basis of the aforementioned facts and submissions at the Bar, the order dated 06.07.2023 passed in Gosaninuagaon P.S. Case No.13 of 2021 arising out of G.R. Case No.49 of 2021 pending in the Court of the learned Addl.

Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge (POCSO) Berhampur, Ganjam is set aside, subject to the petitioner surrendering before the Court below and paying cost of Rs.500/-
(Rupees five hundred) before the Orissa High Court Advocates' Welfare Fund.

entities.text: Orissa High Court Advocates' Welfare Fund
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 5. The CRLMC is accordingly disposed of.
Location: High Court of Orissa, Cuttack.
